                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;

<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')

    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)

    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)

</script>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px; line-height:1.4em; text-align:center;"> </p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px; line-height:1.4em; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:15px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:helvetica-w01-roman,helvetica-w02-roman,helvetica-lt-w10-roman,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">We provide support instrumental in helping students attend dozens of prominent colleges and universities. We have years of experience providing comprehensive admissions counseling including MBA admission and PhD admission help. We also match academic and social goals along with transitional support for our students. Our wide-ranging clientele and outstanding consultants have formed a cross-disciplinary global team that makes us one of the best-known consulting companies worldwide. </span></span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-l7fvihdd" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL PO9MfV comp-l7fvihdd wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:47px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:47px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:playfairdisplay-bold,playfair display,serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0.01em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our Concept</span></span></span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-l7fv6fxz" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL PO9MfV comp-l7fv6fxz wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px; line-height:1.4em; text-align:justify;"><span style="font-size:15px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:helvetica-w01-roman,helvetica-w02-roman,helvetica-lt-w10-roman,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="color:#000000;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">For almost a decade, we have successfully consulted with thousands of students and their families from around the world to achieve impressive admissions tailored to their specific needs. We accomplish this by partnering students with an early education, K-12, undergraduate, or graduate admissions advisor to help them complete the admissions process. We know how significant it is for students to have the best guidance including support to help them meet academic and career goals. </span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:15px; line-height:1.4em; text-align:justify;"> </p>
